docs.purpose: The one mobile surface binding: SearchBinding.tsx maps a SEARCH situation to a props tree (refs only) and SurfaceRenderer.tsx renders a props tree through the closed COMPONENTS table (bindings.json mapping.mobile) into the vendored React Native Reusables parts. It holds no display text of its own.
docs.data_story: It reads nothing itself: the mount file passes the situation, the content strings (the generated slice) and the bound data.
docs.under_126: **PROMOTED BINDING ENTRY** (P42-D9 a; MF-35 plan v2 §2.3): a platform_shared census entry that owns the binding modules, so R-13 totality holds while the converted surfaces own no component.

identity.owner: Admin domain (Spec 126 §14 Target Files) — the conversion programme owns the row; no individual owner is named by Specs 126/127/128.

versioning.why: Nothing consumes this surface: it does not exist, so no compatibility promise can have been made. It gains a promise at its C9 cutover, when its golden pair is captured.
evidence: docs/specs/02-web-admin/126_maxbld_surface_standard.md §2.2 — listed among the 11 NEW admin surfaces
docs/specs/02-web-admin/127_surface_conversion_procedure.md §4.3 — the golden PAIR is what pins a shape

inputs.why: Descriptor, content and data arrive as props from the mount file.

outputs.why: A binding writes nothing; a form submit is handed back to the mount file.

state.why: No store: the library component holds its own local UI state.

staleness.why: It renders what it is given.

session.why: Its only consumer today is the MaxBLD search page; each consumer declares its own guard.

rls_class.why: It renders lookup data the consumer already read through GET /api/parcels/lookup (parcels and address points, Class B); it reads no table itself.
evidence: src/app/api/parcels/lookup/route.ts — the route the consumer calls

checks.why: The two modules are listed in bindings.json modules and owned by this entry (FE-31 C-3); a module nobody owns is a hand-built component.

errors.why: Errors belong to the consuming surface; the binding throws on a missing content key or an unknown widget so a gap is loud.

metering.why: Rendering is not a metered product action.

sharing.why: Every converted mobile surface (the parcel search page first).
sharing.varies_by_surface: Only the props tree, content and data passed in.

notes: MF-35 (P42-D9 a; P35-D10 a; the binding standard 2026-11-10).

programme.why: Shared rendering infrastructure: the binding every converted mobile surface renders through.
